Setup

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

from rent_project.config import (
    ADDRESSBASE_DIRECTORY_RAW,
    ADDRESSBASE_DIRECTORY_INTERIM,
)
from rent_project.load.addressbase import (
    load_full_addressbase,
    load_schema_new,
    load_schema_old,
)
```

AddressBase 2011, 21, 26 - Greater London Clipping

```{python}
#Load schemas
addressbase_schema_old = load_schema_old(ADDRESSBASE_DIRECTORY_RAW / "addressbase-plus-pre-e-39-header.csv")
addressbase_schema_new = load_schema_new(ADDRESSBASE_DIRECTORY_RAW / "addressbase-plus-post-e-39-header.csv")

#Addressbase 2011
ab2011full = load_full_addressbase(
    addressbase_schema_old,
    ADDRESSBASE_DIRECTORY_RAW / "2011" / "greater_london_2011_abplus.csv")
ab2011clipped = load_full_addressbase(
    addressbase_schema_old,
    ADDRESSBASE_DIRECTORY_INTERIM / "greater_london_2011_abplus_clipped.csv")
len(ab2011full.index)
# 4168445 rows
ab2011full['administrative_area'].isna().sum()
# 19 NAs
temp = ab2011full[ab2011full['administrative_area'].isna()] 
# 19 NAs can ignore - not postal addresses
ab2011full['administrative_area'].value_counts(dropna=False)
len(ab2011clipped.index)
# 4059727 rows
ab2011clipped['administrative_area'].isna().sum()
# No NAs
ab2011clipped['administrative_area'].value_counts(dropna=False)
del [ab2011full, ab2011clipped, temp]

#Addressbase 2021
ab2021full = load_full_addressbase(
    addressbase_schema_new,
    ADDRESSBASE_DIRECTORY_RAW / "2021" / "greater_london_2021_abplus.csv")
ab2021clipped = load_full_addressbase(
    addressbase_schema_new,
    ADDRESSBASE_DIRECTORY_INTERIM / "greater_london_2021_abplus_clipped.csv")
len(ab2021full.index)
# 4638995 rows
ab2021full['administrative_area'].isna().sum()
# No NAs
ab2021full['administrative_area'].value_counts(dropna=False)
len(ab2021clipped.index)
# 4638561 rows
ab2021clipped['administrative_area'].isna().sum()
# No NAs
ab2021clipped['administrative_area'].value_counts(dropna=False)
del [ab2021full, ab2021clipped]

#Addressbase 2026
ab2026full = load_full_addressbase(
    addressbase_schema_new,
    ADDRESSBASE_DIRECTORY_RAW / "2026" / "greater_london_2026_abplus.csv")
ab2026clipped = load_full_addressbase(
    addressbase_schema_new,
    ADDRESSBASE_DIRECTORY_INTERIM / "greater_london_2026_abplus_clipped.csv")
len(ab2026full.index)
# 5269531 rows
ab2026full['administrative_area'].isna().sum()
# No NAs
ab2026full['administrative_area'].value_counts(dropna=False)
len(ab2026clipped.index)
# 4842842 rows
ab2026clipped['administrative_area'].isna().sum()
# No NAs
ab2026clipped['administrative_area'].value_counts(dropna=False)
del [ab2026full, ab2026clipped]

```
